rules.definition: Trinity IsPassive = DB2 SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE OR ActiveIconFileDataId==135754 OR spell 59630
rules.name: effective-passive
rules.population: all providers 189140: passive 16812 (56 by correction only); player 4218: passive 3453 (0 by correction only)

rules.definition: A second application of a passive never finds the existing object (IsMultiSlotAura, Unit.cpp:3395): same caster & no cast item -> new object, old removed BY_DEFAULT (state reset); item-sourced -> coexist; passive without APPLY_AURA effect -> coexist (IsPassiveStackableWithRanks)
rules.name: passive-reapplication-never-refreshes
rules.population: passive: all 16812, player 3453; no-APPLY_AURA passives all 118 / player 5

rules.definition: A passive is permanent iff it has no DurationEntry (SpellAuras.cpp:925); with one it expires
rules.name: passive-duration
rules.population: passives with finite duration: all 9, player 0

rules.definition: Owner death removes neither the owned passive nor its applications (Unit.cpp:4479/4488); actives survive only with SPELL_ATTR3_ALLOW_AURA_WHILE_DEAD
rules.name: passive-survives-death

rules.definition: Passives are skipped by dispel lists, spell steal, immunity purge, CMSG_CANCEL_AURA and arena entry
rules.name: passive-unremovable-by-players-and-dispels

rules.definition: Passives are never saved (CanBeSaved SpellAuras.cpp:1170): all their mutable state resets at every login
rules.name: passive-not-saved
rules.population: passive: all 16812, player 3453; with any mutable carrier: all 6316, player 1049

rules.definition: A points SpellMod change recalculates amounts of the caster's own passive/permanent auras; temporary actives keep their application snapshot (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1233), literal exception 384669
rules.name: spellmod-recalculates-passive-amounts

rules.definition: Candidate: a passive aura carries no mutable state (the Core/selected-package assumption)
rules.name: passive-is-immutable
rules.population: counterexamples with >=1 mutable carrier: all 6316 of 16812, player 1049 of 3453

rules.definition: Once removed by interrupt, REMOVE_AURA effect, charges, expiry, form or aura-state loss, a passive returns only on an acquisition event (login, relearn, trait/spec edit, equip, form entry, state gain); Trinity has no re-application loop
rules.name: no-self-restoration
rules.population: passives exposed to such removal (interruptible all 172/player 50; REMOVE_AURA targets all 6; charges all 5/player 2; finite all 9; stances all 25/player 2; aura-state all 8/player 4)

rules.definition: A trait rank change is ApplyTraitEntry(false)+ApplyTraitEntry(true) (Player.cpp:29266-29268): RemoveSpell then LearnSpell -> new aura object; amount re-read from the TraitDefinitionEffectPoints curve
rules.name: rank-change-recreates

rules.definition: Item/set/enchant equip routes cast the spell whether or not it is Passive; actives acquired this way have their own duration and are not re-cast until re-equip/login
rules.name: equip-routes-ignore-passive
rules.population: non-passive providers reached by an equip route: player 7

rules.definition: Learning applies an aura only for passives (gated by Stances, EquippedItemClass, CasterAuraState) and for actives with SPELL_ATTR1_CAST_WHEN_LEARNED (Player.cpp:2912-2927)
rules.name: learn-applies-passives-only

rules.definition: RemoveSpell removes RemoveOwnedAura(spell, self) and spell_pet_auras only; auras the passive cast (procs/scripts/triggers, e.g. Pyrogenics 387096) are untouched
rules.name: unlearn-removes-only-own-aura

trinity_defects.description: Passives with an implemented AuraInterruptFlag are removed by the event and, unless the firing path itself relearns them (ChangeSpec for trait/spec passives), never re-applied: EnterWorld fires in Unit::AddToWorld after LoadFromDB cast the passives, Login fires after login, ChangeGlyph on any glyph apply, and a relearn of a still-known spell early-returns in AddSpell (no recast). E.g. 48263 Veteran of the Third War (Login) is absent after every login; 193468 Mastery: Sniper Training (ChangeGlyph) is lost on a glyph change until relog/spec change.
trinity_defects.lifecycle_effect: permanent loss of a passive until relearn/relog (relog re-loses Login/EnterWorld ones)
trinity_defects.oracle_behaviour: reproduced as removal_policy()['aura-interrupt'] + no-self-restoration; marked likely-defect, Retail UNKNOWN (AL-U-G-01)

trinity_defects.description: Set-bonus removal (ApplyEquipSpell with no item) and mastery removal use RemoveAurasDueToSpell(id) with no caster GUID: they also remove applications of that spell cast by other units.
SpellAuraInterruptFlags2::ChangeTalent fires only in legacy Player::AddTalent; UpdateTraitConfig (all current talent edits) never fires it.
